payload.description:
Researcher first-pass on /workspace/research-pod.

The documented operator path is `papyrus references list --backend local` (Papyrus #54). That binary is not on PATH on the Grok Bot box, so Researcher can only use the throwaway bin/register-ref.py and bin/list-refs.py wrappers.

Fix: land and install the operator CLI so `papyrus` is a real command. Do not keep growing the wrappers as the product interface.
payload.title: papyrus is not on PATH for agent boxes
